package.description: Personal File, Folder and Disk Encryption Software

en-US.description: Personal File, Folder and Disk Encryption Software
en-US.longDescription:
ENCRYPT ANY DATA, ANY DISK, FILES AND FOLDERS ON ANY WINDOWS PC USING CRYPTAINER PERSONAL ENCRYPTION SOFTWARE
- Creates an encrypted drive (vault) for all data
- 448 bit strong encryption
- Easy to use, Impossible to break
- Works on all 32-bit as well as 64-bit versions of Windows.
- Encrypts any data on any media (USB Drives, Flash Disks, Memory Sticks, CD ROM's/DVD's etc)
- Send Secure Emails too
- Simple drag and drop operation
en-US.name: Cryptainer PE 18

zh-CN.description: 个人文件、文件夹和驱动器加密软件
zh-CN.longDescription:
使用 CRYPTAINER 个人加密软件，为任意 Windows 电脑上的数据、磁盘、文件及文件夹进行加密
- 创建加密驱动器（保险库）以保护所有数据
- 采用 448 位高强度加密技术
- 操作简便，安全无懈可击
- 兼容所有 32 位及 64 位 Windows 系统
- 支持任意存储介质加密（U 盘、闪存盘、记忆棒、CD/DVD 光盘等）
- 还可发送安全加密邮件
- 简单拖放即可完成操作
